pb-ca-firm.hold: Your CA checks these dated rules before client work.
pb-ca-firm.changed: These rules changed. Review the current version.
pb-ca-firm.deskLine: Prepare source-backed workings for your CA to review.
pb-ca-firm.caSetup: Name your CA and confirm dated tables
pb-ca-firm.regime: Regime for the boundary or ceiling
pb-ca-firm.templateHint: Paste the completed template or upload its CSV. Amounts are in rupees.
pb-ca-firm.documentHint: Keep masked account numbers masked. Enter credits and debits as positive amounts; page balances must tie.
pb-ca-firm.taxScope: Salary and other slab income only. Unentered deductions and prepaid tax are assumed zero; complex income goes to your CA.
pb-ca-firm.completeTds: I checked that earlier year-to-date payments are complete.
pb-ca-firm.healthHint: Use true or false for flags. Keep unknown GSTIN and TDS cells empty. Missing TDS facts are not a clean bill of health.
pb-ca-firm.sample: Assumed example. No client record was saved.
pb-ca-firm.manual: Preparation only. Nothing is filed, sent or posted to external books.
pb-ca-firm.coverage: {read} of {total} supplied lines read, in two passes.
pb-ca-firm.reviewFirst: Add the CA number, evidence and reason first.
pb-ca-firm.voucherApproved: Approved in Chausar. Enter it in your books manually.
pb-ca-firm.packHint: Typed source figures only. Identifiers stay masked until you approve a needed disclosure. No tax-document readers.
pb-ca-firm.sourceFirst: Choose a client and add source figures.
pb-ca-firm.fields: Choose the fields needed by the form
pb-ca-firm.reveal: Reveal {field} because the form needs it
pb-ca-firm.exportFirst: Choose fields, recipient and purpose first.
pb-ca-firm.packReceipt: Each figure is converted exactly from the owner-supplied source. Tax treatment is for the CA to confirm.
pb-ca-firm.error.generic: Check the source fields and try again. Nothing was sent.
pb-ca-firm.error.RATE_UNCONFIRMED: Your CA must confirm these dated tables first.
pb-ca-firm.error.NEEDS_FACTS: More facts are needed. Ask your CA before continuing.
pb-ca-firm.error.NOT_MODELLED: This is outside the encoded law. Your CA works it manually.
pb-ca-firm.error.STATEMENT_DOES_NOT_TIE: The statement does not tie. Check each page and its opening and closing balances.
pb-ca-firm.error.CA_WORK_CHANGED: The working changed. Read it again before approving.
pb-ca-firm.error.CA_WORK_SOURCE_CHANGED: The source receipt changed or is unavailable. Prepare a fresh working.
pb-ca-firm.error.CA_NOT_OF_RECORD: Only the named CA of record can decide this finding.
pb-ca-firm.error.CA_FINDING_EVIDENCE_REQ: Select the checked source evidence and add the CA reason.
pb-ca-firm.error.CA_PACK_CHANGED: The pack changed. Review its fields again.
pb-ca-firm.error.CA_PACK_APPROVAL_REQUIR: Approve the exact fields and disclosures shown.
pb-ca-firm.reportInstructions: After every finding is decided, copy this exact appendix into the delivery draft. Your CA signs that draft before you render or share the read-only report.
